page.layout: One block of running text in a single column; running head at top with page number at top right; catchword/signature at foot. No marginal notes.

main_text.l: verba quarti præcepti, Memento vel obser-
vato diem Sabbati ut sanctifices eum, pos-
rit ille dies atq; id tempus, quo absolutum
ritur, vide & cura diligenter ut id tempus,
gratias agens illi pacificatori, tùm eum
id distinguas à tempore sitis, servitutis,
sanctificanda fuit; multò magis cessatio per eum
quo sensu hoc præceptum sine dubio Morale
est, sed pertinens ad fœdus gratiæ:
quàm figuram melioris quietis. Velim au-
quietis esse typum, non verò numerum
diei in septimanâ ad typum ullo modo

page.notes: Printed with a faint page-edge shadow on the right; the marginal ink marks are stains, not text. Running head and page number as printed. Some words in the last lines are blurred (e.g. "Morale", "typum") but were read.
